newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Fama Holdings Limited signs beach development deal worth 40.5 billion riyals.
- Over 70 percent of the work on the four-billion-riyal Shuaibah power project completed.
- Road works project to cut accidents by 50 percent.
- Savola Company of Saudi Arabia reports net profit of 61 million riyals for the first nine months of 1996.
